vaultSpellNote.message:
• With this spell and a single encrypted Vault file (or its backup), you can get your memories back on another PC, after reinstalling Windows, or as another Windows user. No other file is needed.
• Memocampus does not store the spell and cannot show it again. If you lose it, use “Reissue the Recovery Spell” while the Vault can still be opened, to make a new Vault with a new spell.
• Anyone who knows the spell can read the contents if they have the Vault file (or a backup). Do not tell it to anyone.
• Uppercase and lowercase letters are different. When copying it onto paper, mind the difference between 0 (zero) and O (the letter), between 1, l and I, and between - (hyphen) and _ (underscore).
• “Copy” puts the spell on the clipboard. It may remain on the clipboard or in the Windows clipboard history, so clear it once you have stored the spell.

optionsRuleHelp.message: Pattern uses Memocampus pattern matching. Regex is judged with Rust regex syntax; look-ahead and look-behind are not supported. Domain Wildcard has the form “*.example.com” and matches example.com itself and all of its sub-domains (only the host name is judged; the path, query and port are not looked at). Public suffixes such as *.com or *.co.jp cannot be used. Exact URL matches exactly one whole URL starting with a scheme (such as https): the scheme, host, port, path, query and fragment must all be the same. The case of the host name and the default port make no difference. A different trailing / or query makes it a different URL.

optionsStartNotStarted.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: nothing is retried automatically.

optionsStartUnknown.message: The start state cannot be checked. $reason$ The start request is not sent again. Use “Check the start state again” or “Reload”.
optionsStartUnknown.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: nothing is retried automatically.

optionsStartInvalid.message: Recording was not started because the draft could not be validated. Check the validation result.
optionsStartInvalid.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: says what was NOT changed or sent; must not read as done.

optionsStartedElsewhere.message: Recording was already started from another page. The current settings are shown.

optionsApplyValidateFailed.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: says what was NOT changed or sent; must not read as done.

optionsApplyConflict.message: Not applied because the privacy settings were changed by another page or process. They are not overwritten automatically. The draft is kept as it is. Review it, then load the latest settings with “Reload” (reloading discards this draft).
optionsApplyConflict.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: says what was NOT changed or sent; must not read as done.

optionsApplyRefused.message: Not applied. $error$ The draft is kept as it is.
optionsApplyRefused.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: says what was NOT changed or sent; must not read as done.

optionsAppliedNewer.message: Applied (Revision $revision$). There were other changes afterwards, so the latest settings (Revision $latest$) are shown.

optionsAppliedUnread.message: The apply succeeded (Revision $revision$), but the latest state could not be retrieved. $reason$ The draft is kept. Choose “Check the apply result again”.

optionsApplyUnknownChecking.message: The result of the apply is unknown. $error$ Reading the current settings to check…
optionsApplyUnknownChecking.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: never reported as applied or as not applied before the check.

optionsApplyNotApplied.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: nothing is retried automatically.

optionsApplyChanged.message: While the result of the apply was unknown, the privacy settings changed to something other than this draft (Revision $revision$). They are not overwritten automatically. The draft is kept. Review it, then load the latest settings with “Reload”.
optionsApplyChanged.description: Privacy settings page (options-page.js). SAFETY: says what was NOT changed or sent; must not read as done.

optionsPresetFailed.message: The initial proposal cannot be retrieved. Recording has not started. Check the Native Host and reload.
